description: Implementation of Bbr2 congestion control algorithms, including classes and methods for managing network state, congestion events, and bandwidth estimation in QUIC protocol.

classes.name: RoundTripCounter
classes.description: Tracks the number of round trips based on packet acknowledgments.

classes.name: MinRttFilter
classes.description: Maintains and updates the minimum RTT measurement.

classes.name: Bbr2NetworkModel
classes.description: Implements BBRv2 congestion control logic, managing network state, congestion events, and bandwidth estimation.

methods.name: RoundTripCounter::OnPacketSent
methods.description: Records a sent packet and updates internal state.

methods.name: RoundTripCounter::OnPacketsAcked
methods.description: Updates round trip count upon acknowledgment of packets.

methods.name: MinRttFilter::Update
methods.description: Updates the minimum RTT measurement with a new sample.

methods.name: MinRttFilter::ForceUpdate
methods.description: Forcefully updates the minimum RTT measurement.

methods.name: Bbr2NetworkModel::OnPacketSent
methods.description: Handles logic when a packet is sent, updating network state.

methods.name: Bbr2NetworkModel::OnCongestionEventStart
methods.description: Processes the start of a congestion event, updating bandwidth and RTT estimates.

methods.name: Bbr2NetworkModel::AdaptLowerBounds
methods.description: Adjusts lower bounds for bandwidth and inflight based on congestion events.

methods.name: Bbr2NetworkModel::OnCongestionEventFinish
methods.description: Finalizes congestion event processing, cleaning obsolete data.

methods.name: Bbr2NetworkModel::UpdateNetworkParameters
methods.description: Updates network parameters based on RTT measurements.

methods.name: Bbr2NetworkModel::MaybeExpireMinRtt
methods.description: Expires the minimum RTT measurement if conditions are met.

methods.name: Bbr2NetworkModel::IsInflightTooHigh
methods.description: Determines if the current inflight data is too high based on loss events.

methods.name: Bbr2NetworkModel::OnNewRound
methods.description: Initializes state for a new round.

methods.name: Bbr2NetworkModel::inflight_hi_with_headroom
methods.description: Calculates inflight high with headroom margin.

methods.name: Bbr2NetworkModel::HasBandwidthGrowth
methods.description: Checks if bandwidth is still growing.
